purpose: Provide a canonical, evidence-aware and risk-proportional project contract that Symphonie can parse into phase briefs without transferring execution authority.

separation_of_ownership.lab: Schemas, transversal rules, validated patterns, rejected patterns, evidence standards and contract interpretation semantics.
separation_of_ownership.symphonie: Context resolution, phase planning, brief generation, gate orchestration and evidence reconciliation.
separation_of_ownership.project_repository: Project-specific contract instance, architecture, implementation, tests, runtime evidence and operational state.
